scope: Every clip was submitted to the hosted exercise pipeline in the same container image the Cloudflare Worker runs, and completed the whole chain: admission, articulated body and authored ground, executable task, bounded training, and the policy-versus-baselines comparison. Licences are the original creators'; derived files are explicit re-encodes under the same licence. Simulated joint control, not measured anatomy or validated biomechanics.

constraints.works: one person head to feet, plain background, fixed camera, one continuous shot
constraints.fails: camera cuts, wall mirrors, bystanders - each reads as a competing person; long occlusions break the root reference
constraints.envelope: MP4, under 40 MB, at most 480 decoded frames after normalization, long side up to 1920, 1-240 fps
constraints.borderline: A clip near the pose-usability threshold can pass on one machine and fail on another, and re-encoding it can flip the result. Only clips verified through the hosted container image are listed here.

how_to_submit: Upload the MP4 with the exercise pipeline selected. The slowest clip here finished in 43 s end to end and none needed normalization, so the file you upload is the file the pipeline reads. Two submission routes reach the same lab by different paths and admit different clips: check each record's `paths` before choosing. Everything tiered showcase or backup passes both.

clips.title: Jumping jacks and burpees
clips.creator: Taco Fleur / Cavemantraining (Wikimedia Commons)
clips.derivation: WebM transcoded to H.264 MP4, then strided to 452 frames at 10 fps so the whole 45 s fits the 500-frame envelope both routes enforce. The unstrided 1,350-frame version is refused locally on the envelope.
clips.why: A hard refusal everywhere until a window of its own evidence was asked for: 45 s with several people, now admitted on 20.9-45.2 s by both routes and learning 100/100. The clearest demonstration that a localized defect no longer costs the whole clip.

routes: Both routes can use a window of a clip's own evidence, by different means. The hosted lane proposes and retries automatically. The local portal records the proposal beside the preserved refusal and one explicit request to /api/projects/<id>/perception/supported-window builds a child on it; a harness that stops at the refusal understates the local route. The remaining difference is normalization: the hosted lane strides an over-long clip to fit the frame envelope before admission, the local upload path does not.
